# Leave Application Procedure

Owner: Human Resources
Audience: all staff

## Annual leave

Apply in the HR portal at least 5 working days in advance. Leave over 10
consecutive days needs department-head approval plus a handover note.

## Sick leave

Notify your supervisor on the first day. A medical certificate is required
for absences longer than 3 days.

## Public holidays

Leave days are not deducted for public holidays that fall inside an
approved leave period.
